scope: Exploratory frozen-output endpoint/exclusion sensitivity. Two settings selected after original-label inventory and before sensitivity result calculation. No model retraining, recalibration, manuscript edits or policy optimization.

settings.rule: Original labels and all resource records
Only provider diagnoses malignant- ak / actinic keratosis / AK become binary endpoint 0 (non-cancer for this malignancy endpoint). All rows stay in resources; all other labels unchanged.
settings.rationale: AK is documented as precancerous by dermatology societies. Sensitivity to including known AK in the non-cancer denominator, not a claim that AK needs no clinical action.

settings.rule: Remove every reference y=-1 row from outcomes and the imaging/flag resource denominator. No relabeling of retained rows. Recompute counts, baseline flags/FP and integer image/flag capacities using retained N; original B/P/R decisions and fold membership retained.
settings.rationale: Explicit alternative to the current choice to retain endpoint-excluded lesions in resource budgets. This is a different observed analysis population, not a correction for missingness or dermoscopy selection bias.

reporting: Cohort N, known endpoints, excluded, cancer/subtype counts, groups
Feasible n/36, n/100 at each budget; primary/repaired gain in pp
Repaired cap and cohort breakdown; table-level changes
Nonexclusive six-margin failure counts and exclusive support/capacity/feasible decomposition
C_minus and B_plus support, required rescues and minimum image counts
validation: Join all 9168 original field slices to frozen IDs/groups and reconcile original endpoint mapping
Reconstruct all236 count tables and reference verdicts
Independent allocation MILP for every table/setting/budget; integer witness checks for feasible cases
Check no label changes outside declared sets; fixed decisions and original delivery unchanged
not_tested: Alternative pathological adjudication of ambiguous lesions
New acquisition-policy fitting, prospective efficacy, verification stopping-cost recomputation
